resources.string:
SatsKeeper earns money by sharing a small part of your device's internet connection with a partner network. In return you earn points that you can redeem for gift cards.

What this means:
• Other people's internet traffic can be routed through your connection, so it may appear to come from your IP address.
• It uses some mobile data and battery. Use Wi-Fi if your data plan is limited.
• Nothing is shared until you tap "I agree" below.
• Your choice is saved with the date and time.

You can stop at any time with the switch on the main screen. Sharing stops immediately and the points you already earned are kept.
